name: 02882 · Narragansett, RI
findings: ZIP 02882 (Narragansett) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02882 (Narragansett) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02882 (Narragansett) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
